name: poteto-workflow
description: Gated engineering workflow with four stages and seven crew gates for test-first, independently reviewed, secret-scanned delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Interrogate, arena, swarm, show your work, under hard crew gates.
interface.longDescription: Runs a change through four stages (interrogate the premise, run an arena on real forks, swarm independent units, show the evidence) and holds it to seven crew gates: a failing test before the fix, review by a different model family, gitleaks before every commit and pull request, the full suite green, owner approval for merge, deploy and force-push, no AI co-author trailers, and tiered model routing.
defaultPrompt: Use $poteto-workflow to deliver this change test-first, with an independent review and a secret scan before the pull request.
